title: House Price Prediction
description: End-to-end machine learning project on the Ames Housing dataset — from data cleaning and feature engineering through regularized regression and gradient boosting models to predict final home sale prices.
businessProblem: Predict the final sale price of residential homes in Ames, Iowa from 79 explanatory variables describing (almost) every aspect of the property.
workflow: Explore the SalePrice target distribution and log-transform for skew
Impute missing values across numeric and categorical features
Handle high-cardinality categorical features with target encoding
Engineer features (total square footage, age, remodel age, quality scores)
Select features via correlation and mutual information
Train Ridge, Lasso, and XGBoost models with cross-validation
Evaluate with RMSE on log-transformed SalePrice
